recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d ; /signingConfigs \{/,/^    \}/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --target-platform android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
